The 2007 runner-up was Lewis Hamilton, who drove for **McLaren**. The standings list him second with 109 points, one behind champion Kimi Räikkönen (Ferrari) on 110. His teammate Fernando Alonso is also listed on 109 points, but both drove for McLaren, so the team is the same either way.

ANSWER: McLaren
